tasks.draft:
Hi Marcus,

Thank you so much for taking the time to report this issue and for your patience while we looked into it. We really appreciate you sharing your experience with our SDK, as feedback like yours helps us make the product better for everyone.

I've had a chance to dig into what you're seeing, and I'm happy to report that I was able to identify the root cause. The quickstart sample passes the amount as a float (19.99), but the API actually expects the amount as an integer number of cents (1999). Unfortunately, the 'Invalid request' error message didn't make this clear, which I understand must have been frustrating.

In the meantime, the workaround is to pass amount=1999 instead of a float. I've also already updated the quickstart docs page so that it reflects the correct format going forward.

On top of that, we will be shipping SDK v2.4.1 on Thursday, November 20, which will raise a clear error that names the offending field, so this kind of problem will be much easier to diagnose in the future.

Please don't hesitate to let me know if you have any questions or if there's anything else I can help with. We're always here to help!

Best regards,
[Your name]
